english.title: Making a gaming machine available for use in contravention of regulations under section 240 - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a gaming machine available for use in contravention of regulations under section 240 of the Gambling Act 2005
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 242(2) and 246(1) of the Gambling Act 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
made a gaming machine available for use
in contravention of regulations under s. 240 of the Gambling Act 2005

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is also an offence to make a gaming machine available for use other than in accordance with an operating licence, see offence wording GA05051/H8230.
(ii) It is a separate offence for a person to use premises for making a gaming machine available for use without the necessary authorisation or exemption, such as a premises licence or a Category D gaming machine permit (section 137(1)(c) of the Gambling Act 2005, see offence wordings GA05002/H8181, GA05003/H8182 and GA05004/H8183).
(iii) For the territorial application of this section see section 251 of the Gambling Act 2005.
(iv) A licensing authority may institute criminal proceedings in respect of this offence, section 346(1) of the Gambling Act 2005.

other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
